top_signals.title: Pressure on U.S. Treasurys eases after 30-year yield hits highest level since 2002
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury yields were lower on Wednesday after a fresh round of selloffs the previous day, as investors remained concerned about inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
